caseSchedule: Same ten seeded cases for every pair; field-nearest 4, field-operators 3, field-advance 3; both seats played per case
winner: Highest paired-fixture win fraction. Draws are not wins. If tied, only tied leaders play five fresh fixtures per pair; repeat tie-break rounds until a unique leader.
target: 20 wins from 20 main-stage fixtures against the two other candidates in the recorded round. This is not a guarantee against future policies or the official judge.
nextRound: All three start from the published champion; two defeated agents must inherit it before independent improvements and mutual attacks.
release: Publish each unique champion after source/package/Linux verification; download verify then remove previous bot Release.
limitations: Only first two night totals 35/36 come from field summary; later growth, spawn and robot target/move rules are hypotheses.
Full field input/settlement logs and official tasks/news/treasure are unavailable.
